en.Игровой сеанс: план питания — {0}, приор: Game session: power plan — {0}, game priority — {1}, standby memory cleanup — {2}
en.Сохраняются: добавленные папки с играми: Kept: the game folders you added and the list of programs for game mode
en.Язык интерфейса не меняется: The interface language is not changed
en.Изменения системы и журнал отката не зат: System changes and the change log are not affected
en.АВТО — язык Windows. Выбранный язык прим: AUTO — the Windows language. The chosen language is applied after Lycoris restarts.
en.Включено: запрос UAC при каждом запуске,: On: a UAC prompt at every start and all buttons work at once. Off: Lycoris opens without UAC in view-only mode, asks for rights on the first change and carries on by itself. Takes effect at the next start.
en.Перед применением показывается точный сп: The exact list of changes is shown before applying. If you turn this off, tweaks are applied immediately; deleting files, installing drivers and other irreversible actions still ask for confirmation.
en.Как часто «Панель» опрашивает загрузку п: How often the “Dashboard” polls CPU, GPU, memory and disk load. Less often — less load from Lycoris itself.
en.Всё хранится на этом компьютере, ничего: Everything is stored on this computer, nothing is sent over the network.
en.Возвращает параметры Lycoris к значениям: Returns Lycoris settings to their defaults. System changes, the change log and game folders are not affected.
en.ЧТО Lycoris НЕ ДЕЛАЕТ И ПОЧЕМУ: WHAT Lycoris DOES NOT DO AND WHY
en.Bahnschrift, Segoe UI Variable, Cascadia: Bahnschrift, Segoe UI Variable, Cascadia Mono / Consolas, Segoe Fluent Icons are Windows system fonts. They are not distributed with Lycoris.
en.Поведение программы, данные и сведения о: Program behavior, data and information about Lycoris.
en.Исходные значения всего, что менял Lycor: Original values of everything Lycoris changed. Undo works from it.
en.Копии разделов реестра (.reg) перед кажд: Copies of registry keys (.reg) before every batch of changes.
en.Ежедневные логи консоли и отчёты; хранят: Daily console logs and reports; kept for 14 days.
en.Параметры Lycoris для текущего пользоват: Lycoris settings for the current Windows user.
en.Исходное значение записывается в журнал: The original value is written to the log before the system changes. Any settings change (registry, services, tasks, power plans) can be undone — one by one, as a batch or all at once.
en.Перед каждым пакетом изменений создаётся: A Windows restore point is created before every batch of changes (if system protection is on), and the affected registry keys are copied to .reg.
en.Каждый пункт честно описывает свой эффек: Every item honestly describes its effect — even if it is close to zero. Tricks without a working mechanism and “boosters” are not included.
en.Центр обновления, Защитник, брандмауэр,: Windows Update, Defender, the firewall, network, sound and other critical services are never changed.
en.Реестр не «чистится»: Microsoft не подде: The registry is not “cleaned”: Microsoft does not support such programs, there is no benefit, and the risk of breaking the system is real.
en.Удаление файлов, установка драйверов и п: Deleting files, installing drivers and programs, and network reset cannot be undone from the log — so a confirmation with a list of consequences is always shown first.
en.Язык изменится после перезапуска Lycoris: The language will change after Lycoris restarts.
en.Параметры Lycoris вернутся к значениям п: Lycoris settings will return to their defaults.
en.Настройки сброшены к значениям по умолча: Settings were reset to their defaults.
en.Если с последней очистки прошло больше д: When the last cleanup is more than two weeks old, the PC checks show «Time to service the PC» with a button to the cleanup preview. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation.
